upload.title: Upload Document (.PDF, .TXT, .MD)
upload.desc: Upload books, research papers, or articles. Files are permanently archived in the Data Vault and embedded via text-embedding-004.
upload.drag_drop: Drag and drop your file here, or click to browse

raw.title: Paste Raw Text Notes or Excerpts
raw.desc: Directly paste text content from articles, lectures, or summaries. It will be archived into a permanent text file in the Data Vault.

media.title: Video / Audio Ingestion (Speech-to-Text)
media.desc: Upload audio recordings or lecture videos. Audio is transcribed to text, stored in the Data Vault, and indexed into the vector store.
media.drag_drop: Drag and drop audio or video file here

url.title: Web URL Content Scraper
url.desc: Automatically scrape article content, research posts, or fatwas from web links without requiring API keys.

docs.title: Master Document Ingestion & Management Hub
docs.desc: Complete administrative control: Upload PDFs and books, paste text, transcribe speech, scrape web URLs, edit metadata, and permanently delete documents and vectors.
docs.search_placeholder: Search documents by title, category, supervisor...
docs.confirm_delete_msg: Are you sure you want to permanently delete this document and all its 768-dim vector embeddings from the database? This action cannot be undone.
docs.modal_edit_desc: Update document title, category, and language across all vector records.

audit.title: Supervisor Ingestion Audit Logs & Page Productivity
audit.desc: Track productivity, exact page counts, timestamps down to the second, and category breakdowns for every supervisor.
audit.search_placeholder: Filter audit logs by title, category, supervisor...

supervisors.title: Supervisor Profiles & Chunks Breakdown
supervisors.desc: Click on any supervisor card to inspect their exact indexed documents, upload types, and chunks.

categories.title: Dynamic Category Management
categories.desc: Add, edit, or delete metadata categories. Changes reflect instantly across Supervisor upload menus.
